purpose: Machine-readable schema for Neo4j KG ingestion and schema-aware agentic Text-to-Cypher retrieval.
modellingRules: Stable biological entities are separated from sample-specific observation nodes.
Single-cell assays are regular :Assay nodes discriminated by assayType, platform, libraryStrategy, omicsInfo, and isSingleCellAssay. There is no :SingleCellAssay label.
Single-cell data is represented through CellSet, CellType, and CellState. Individual :Cell nodes are not part of the schema.
Intervention subtype labels (Drug, Radiation, Immunotherapy, Surgery, Therapy, Exposure) are additional labels on the same :Intervention node and have no independent primary key.
Perturbation is not an intervention subtype; it is a separate node linked by UNDERWENT_PERTURBATION.
Dense matrices remain external to Neo4j; the graph stores selected materialised observations and external file pointers.
Relationship existence is not enforced. Relationship properties describe the association, not the identity of either node.
Mirror ID properties (e.g. ExpressionObservation.sampleId) support fast filtering; canonical traversal uses relationships.
